rationale.ai-review: Secondary auditor and semantic model judge code, intent, and agent reasoning.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Sandboxed behavioral analysis and cryptographic provenance checks provide grounded detection.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: ARA and CGI detect divergence from stated intent and operating parameters.
rationale.provenance-auditability: PCV persistently records model, context, tools, and reasoning for human audits.
rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Taxonomy and controls address poisoned tool outputs, permissions, and tool-chain compromise.
rationale.org-governance: CGI maintains risk registers, policy gates, GRC feeds, and audit evidence.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: UAST maps operational controls and evidence to NIST RMF and ISO 42001.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Original AVT classifies agentic security vulnerabilities and their control-evasion profiles.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Agent throughput and systemic replication make human-timescale security review impractical.
rationale.metrics: Defines a reusable security risk score extending CVSS with agentic dimensions.
